verdict.line: You lose if you walk into her Hallowed Mist chasing a kill and eat a full Snip Snip! cone; you win if you force the fight while her W is down and double-tap W on her face.

brief.thesis: Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) only stuns 'the first one he Attacks,' which means he has to already be in range to use it — and Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) exists specifically to deny that target-lock by making her untargetable to anyone standing outside the mist. The whole lane is about timing your all-in to when that mist is down, because Gwen has no real ranged disengage otherwise: her Q is a 450-range cone, not a dash, and her only mobility tool (E) needs to land a hit to refund its cooldown. The data backs this up — Volibear holds both the lane-win and solo-kill edge here, so patience, not greed, is what converts that edge.

theirWindow.what: She's immune to being targeted unless you step into the mist, so she can freely poke with Q (Snip Snip!) cone and E (Skip 'n Slash) auto resets while you can't threaten Q or W back. Don't walk in to force a trade here — bait the mist to expire instead.

yourWindow.what: She has zero targeting-denial left. Walk to 325 range, open W (Frenzied Maul) to mark her, follow with Q (Thundering Smash) to stun, then recast W on the same mark for the bonus damage and heal.

powerCurve.note: Both poking at range before W snowballs
W double-tap heal wins extended trades
R lets you force dives, solo-kill her

start.why: The highest-winrate start in this matchup (50% over 84 games, 71.2% pick) — the extra sustain covers the early exchanges while Gwen's Q and passive chip you down before your W rank-ups come online.

boots.why: Top pick at 48.9% over 45 games (40.9% pick) — the magic resist directly blunts Gwen's Q cone, E on-hit, and A Thousand Cuts passive damage, all of which are magic.

core.why: First item in the highest-sampled core path (50% over 12 games) — gives you the stat spread to keep winning the W-Q sustain trades.
Cooldown refund on crits pushes your 5s W back down even further, letting you double-tap the heal more often in skirmishes.
Boosts your W recast heal and your Q/W passive sustain while adding more magic resist against her magic-damage kit.

situational.when: you want faster wave clear and extra on-hit proc damage to punish her squishiness
the game drags into long skirmishes and you need more sustain and poke damage to close out trades
her A Thousand Cuts healing is keeping her alive through your all-ins and you need grievous wounds

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks attack speed fast to pair with your passive's own attack-speed grant, letting your W-spam trades and on-hit damage ramp up quicker than Gwen can answer.

summoners.why: The most-picked and strongest combo here (48.4% WR, 78.2% pick) — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills and applies grievous wounds, directly cutting into the healing her A Thousand Cuts passive relies on.

playing.title: Open with W, not Q
playing.detail: W (Frenzied Maul) is only a 5s cooldown and marks the target for bonus damage and a heal on recast — lead trades with it instead of saving Q, since Q's 10-12s cooldown is too valuable to burn on a non-committal poke.

playing.title: Never chase into her mist
playing.detail: While Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) is up, she can't be targeted unless you step inside it — walking in just to poke hands her a free trade. Wait it out.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: The sustain only triggers if you cast W a second time on the same marked target, so in an extended trade always return to the champion you already marked instead of spreading damage.

playing.title: Step out of her Q cone
playing.detail: Snip Snip! deals true damage to whoever's centered in the cone and stacks her passive on every one of its up-to-6 snips — sidestep after the first hit so you're not eating the full true-damage sequence.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed E
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash only refunds its cooldown if the follow-up hit lands — if she dashes and misses, her mobility is gone for the full 11-13s, which is exactly when to commit your own Q engage.

playing.title: Shield through her R with E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter grants you a shield if you're standing inside its own blast when it lands — drop it on yourself before trading into her Needlework poke so the shield is up when the needles land.

playing.title: Use R to dive under tower
playing.detail: Stormbringer temporarily disables nearby towers on landing, letting you turn your solo-kill advantage into a tower dive once it's online at level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and winrate numbers are pulled from measured Volibear-vs-Gwen games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, trade windows, and tactical sequencing are my own analysis of the live game-file mechanics, not measured data.
